title: Installation Jobs: Installation Methods, Crew Pace and Job Size Limits
content:
Ridgeline carries out every **Installation Jobs** record under one of six installation methods. The method is named on the job by its official name, and it fixes the kind of opening the job is suited to, the pace at which one crew works, and the most units a single job may carry.

## Method schedule

| Installation method | Suited to | Openings or door units one crew installs per crew day | Most openings or door units on one job |
|---|---|---|---|
| Insert Pocket Installation | an existing frame that is sound and square | 8 | 40 |
| Full-Frame Installation | an existing frame removed to the rough opening | 5 | 40 |
| Full-Frame Installation with Exterior Trim Wrap | an existing frame removed to the rough opening, with exterior wood trim to be capped | 4 | 40 |
| Masonry Opening Installation | a brick, stone or stucco wall | 4 | 30 |
| Bay and Bow Installation | a bay or bow unit | 1 | 4 |
| Door System Installation | a prehung entry door or patio door | 2 | 6 |

Each method applies only to a job whose units do not exceed that method's limit in the last column: a job carries at most that many openings or door units.

## Parameter definitions

- Openings per crew day: "Openings (or door units) one crew installs per crew day with this method; crew days planned are the units divided by this, rounded up (count)."
- Most units per job: "Most openings or door units one installation job may carry with this method (count)."

## Notes to the schedule

1. The pace column is a count of openings (for the window methods) or door units (for Door System Installation) that one crew installs in one crew day with that method.
2. The limit column is a count of openings or door units; a job at exactly the limit is within it, and a job one unit over it is not.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical examples)

- A hypothetical Masonry Opening Installation job of 30 openings is within that method's limit of 30; the same method could not carry 31 openings on one job.
- A hypothetical Bay and Bow Installation job may carry up to 4 bay or bow units; its crew installs 1 unit per crew day.
- A hypothetical Door System Installation job of 6 door units is at the method's limit of 6, installed at a pace of 2 door units per crew day.
